title: Neon rain street
idea: a woman waits under a shop awning on a rainy neon street at night and says one line
style: anamorphic, teal and magenta grade, Kodak 500T grain in the shadows
subject: a woman in her thirties in a dark raincoat, wet hair pushed back, holding a closed umbrella
setting: a narrow city street at night in heavy rain, neon shop signs reflected in the wet asphalt
light: magenta and cyan neon practicals as key, cool fill from the sky, rim from a passing car

beats.action: she stands under the awning watching the rain, neon reflections sliding across her coat
beats.camera: slow push-in at eye level, framed waist-up

beats.action: a car passes, its headlights sweep across her face; she turns to the camera
she says the line, half smiling
she steps out into the rain and opens the umbrella
beats.camera: slow tilt up following the umbrella

physics: rain falls in straight lines and bounces off the awning edge; her coat is wet and heavy; the umbrella opens with a snap and settles

sound.ambience: steady rain, tyres on wet asphalt, a distant siren
sound.dialogue: She says, quietly, lip-synced: "You're late. Again."

notes: Vertical framing for Reels. Veo adds 'subtitles, captions' to the negative field because there is dialogue.
